senses.sense_definition: A high, prominent point of land that juts out into a body of water; a headland or coastal cliff.

examples.text: A solitary lighthouse stood at the edge of the rocky <w>promontory</w>, guiding ships safely away from the shore.
They climbed to the <w>promontory</w> to take in the breathtaking view of the ocean.

senses.sense_definition: A prominent anatomical projection or protrusion, especially on the sacrum.

examples.text: The surgeon carefully identified the sacral <w>promontory</w> before proceeding with the pelvic fixation.
Anatomical landmarks like the pelvic <w>promontory</w> are critical during complex lumbar spine procedures.

senses.sense_definition: A rounded elevation on the inner wall of the tympanic cavity in the ear.

examples.text: During the middle-ear surgery, the specialist examined the <w>promontory</w> to evaluate the cochlear nerve.
The tympanic <w>promontory</w> indicates the basal turn of the cochlea inside the inner ear.

senses.sense_definition: A location in Box Elder County, Utah, where the First Transcontinental Railroad was officially joined in 1869.

examples.text: Historians gathered at <w>Promontory</w> to commemorate the completion of the transcontinental railway line.
The driving of the golden spike at <w>Promontory</w> marked a historic turning point in American transportation.
